rows.detail: GCN, per-graph GraphNorm, SiLU, residual and attentional graph pooling are concrete.

rows.detail: Masked graph-token attention and FFN operate separately within each graph set.
rows.resolution: Preserve graph/set masks and per-node set identity in every candidate/native paired input.

rows.detail: Paper equation10 specifies two gates from three contexts. Current source uses one set gate and an ungated home token. Historical v2 has two gates plus extra operations.
rows.resolution: Name current release and historical v2 separately. A paper-equation condition requires explicit architecture/initialization decisions and qualification, not a module alias.

rows.detail: Intermediate x^(2) is used in equations9-11 without an earlier defining operation. Gate prose and equation inputs also differ.

rows.resolution: Do not infer the exact published model from one matching term. Retain this as a version/equation ambiguity.

rows.detail: Public synthetic source generates the stated ER node, probability and set-size ranges. It adds an edge to an otherwise empty graph.
rows.resolution: Use the author generator on both sides. Disclose the source extra-edge rule rather than claim an unconditional ER generator.

rows.detail: For each model/task-cell/seed invocation, the saved synthetic schedule explains the paper sample totals:2500x16=40000 training;5 validation visits x8x16=640 cumulatively;32x16=512 testing.
rows.resolution: Preserve fresh independent per-seed RNG streams.640 is cumulative across validation visits, not640 fixed examples at every visit.

rows.detail: RING, BALL, DIST and cardinality extrapolation definitions are implemented with set-wide max-degree anchors and local-graph distances.
rows.resolution: Use exact native target functions and equal accepted graph sets. Do not substitute a different graph diagnostic.

rows.detail: Paper assigns different learning rates to GST and pipeline baselines. Current native runners have a single all-model learning-rate argument.
rows.resolution: Preserve unchanged release runs. Prepare separately named per-model paper-rate runs with all other choices fixed.

rows.detail: USPTO15K source URL, split filenames, reactant parser, edit-derived atom labels and19-dimensional atom features are provided.
rows.resolution: Use original splits/retained atom identities and report parser retention. Do not invent labels for rejected reactions or silently switch to USPTO50K.

rows.detail: Committed USPTO run is first1000 retained TRAIN reactions, not a full-data run. Its parameter counts and AP differ from paper Table3.
rows.resolution: Keep the saved condition as an author pilot. Full-data and paper-table conditions must be separately frozen and paired with the candidate.

rows.detail: Paper says mean/std over seeds. Native report functions use95percent Student-t confidence half-widths.
rows.resolution: Preserve original author outputs. Compute and label sample SD separately for our common report. Never relabel CI as SD.

rows.detail: Strictly improving validation AP selects USPTO weights; synthetic maximizes AP or minimizes distance MAE. These do not terminate early by patience.
rows.resolution: Describe actual fixed training budget and validation checkpoint selection, not an invented patience schedule.

rows.resolution: Record entry/model-construction RNG state for source-native runs. A seed-before-construction correction is a named change, not silently the same experiment.

rows.detail: BH learning-curve branch reserves30percent TEST and applies10percent inner validation capped at50. All seven paper training counts follow from the saved3955-reaction count.
rows.resolution: Choose --train-size-ablation explicitly. The separate default70/10/20 branch does not invalidate this correctly implemented paper branch.

rows.detail: BH target normalization uses the entire70percent training pool before each small training subset is selected. It includes labels outside that subset, but no TEST labels.
rows.paper_reference: Paper low-data claims do not specify normalization label access
rows.resolution: Disclose source-native label access. A subset-only normalization sensitivity is separate; do not claim a strict label-budget experiment without addressing this.

rows.detail: BH runner uses Adam while non-CIFAR paper prose specifies AdamW.
rows.resolution: Keep release optimizer as baseline condition; a paper-optimizer condition must be separately named and qualified.

rows.detail: Current BH and synthetic-v2 runners import gst_v2, absent from current tree. The historical module is recoverable, but these current scripts did not coexist with it.
rows.resolution: A coherent adapter must pin both script and model versions, verify interface/configuration and disclose composition. Do not simply rename gst.py.

rows.detail: Historical CIFAR scripts load official PyG splits and form label-homogeneous graph sets. Fixed runner uses size10/five seeds; variable runner trains5/10/20 and evaluates size1.
rows.resolution: Source is recovered. Paper sizes5/10 and three seeds can be explicit parameter choices, but exact table model/configuration and seed provenance remain unverified.

rows.detail: Set helper may reuse graph members across sets and may return repeated sampled members. This affects dependence of observations, not cross-split mixing when original splits are preserved.

rows.resolution: Freeze exact set membership within each split for paired methods. Do not claim individual sets are independent replicates or silently deduplicate.

rows.resolution: Catalogue these files but do not use unrelated results to fill a missing paper benchmark.
